issue:
# Wrong module name in default ignore list

The default ignore list in `freezegun/config.py` contains 'Queue' instead of 'queue'. This causes issues when trying to extend the default ignore list.

## Reproduction

When trying to use the `configure` method with `extend_ignore_list`, the functionality doesn't work correctly because the default ignore list contains the wrong module name.

```python
import freezegun

# This doesn't work correctly
freezegun.configure(extend_ignore_list=['tensorflow'])
with freezegun.freeze_time('2020-10-06'):
    # The 'queue' module is not properly ignored
    pass
```

The issue is that Python 3 uses the lowercase 'queue' module name, but the default ignore list contains 'Queue' (uppercase), which was the module name in Python 2.

This causes inconsistencies when extending the default ignore list, as the expected module name doesn't match what's actually in the configuration.
